summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K disclosing a new employment agreement with CEO Bin Fu, effective May 1, 2026, for a one-year term. The agreement sets an annual salary of $1 and an optional cash bonus at the board's discretion. This is not a routine renewal but an abrupt shift to nominal compensation, suggesting a non-standard arrangement or retained figurehead. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K. Watch for any subsequent filings indicating a change in control or strategic moves, as the nominal salary may precede a going-private or restructuring transaction.
